terminal-light-selection.purpose: Ghostty selection background in the default light palette.

terminal-dark-selection.purpose: Ghostty selection background in the default dark palette.

catppuccin-accent.purpose: Theme.accent when Catppuccin follows its theme accent.

metadata.purpose: Space branch/directory and Agent context/state words.

pane-title.purpose: Native label-color pane task name at regular weight.

pane-title-focused.purpose: Native label-color pane task name, semibold in the focused pane of the key window.

pane-context.purpose: Secondary monospaced device/session context beside the task name.

search-input.purpose: Borderless AppKit field; native text editing and initial focus.

search-context.purpose: Secondary object context in search results.

themeSources.chrome: App/Theme.swift; workbench foreground is primary and control tint is secondaryLabelColor. Theme accent remains available to selection and focus.
themeSources.defaultTerminal: Explicit light/dark background, foreground and selection in Theme.apply().
themeSources.herdr: Theme.apply resolves supported family from local Herdr configuration on app activation; unsupported families fall back to Default.

pane.topTitleClearance: Additional 3.5pt above the border; total top border inset 7pt.
pane.minimumSizeIntent: At least 24 columns and 6 rows with current font; concrete bounds are computed by Desk.minimumPaneSize.
pane.splitKeyboardIncrement: 5 percentage points, clamped to minimum pane size
pane.outerCorners: On macOS 26+, bottom-right outer corner is rounded; bottom-left is rounded only when sidebar is hidden. Radius refers to rounded.pane-outer-bottom. Other outlines stay rectangular.

stateTreatments.sidebarSelected: Accent fill 0.18 light / 0.20 dark and 1pt accent outline 0.22.
stateTreatments.tabSelected: Theme.accent fill 0.18 light / 0.20 dark and 1pt accent outline 0.22; semibold label.
stateTreatments.tabHover: NSColor.labelColor fill 0.06 for hovered unselected tab.
stateTreatments.paneFocused: Theme.accent border and semibold labelColor main title only in key window.
stateTreatments.paneUnfocused: NSColor.separatorColor border and regular labelColor main title.
stateTreatments.paneContext: Secondary label color independent of focus.
stateTreatments.agentStatus: Working half-filled circle; blocked/unread filled circle; other states outline. Glyph carries status color; Agent row state word is primary.
stateTreatments.deviceConnection: Connected neutral filled circle; offline orange outline, with explicit accessibility/help status.

ghosttyPreferences.fontPreview: Native monospaced system font for SF Mono, custom selected family otherwise; Chinese, ASCII and digits.

accessibility.sidebar: Selected row traits, expandable section state and full help context.
accessibility.agent: Readable state word in each two-line Agent row; standalone status glyphs expose accessible labels.
accessibility.tabs: Radio-button role, selected value and pane-count help.
accessibility.panes: Full title/context label on terminal view; contextual close labels and VoiceOver-visible close controls.
accessibility.splitters: Splitter roles with value/min/max, keyboard adjustments and accessibility increment/decrement.
accessibility.search: Native field-editor command routing, marked-text guard and stable result identity; operational acceptance remains separate.

brandProvenance.description: Original user-supplied purple diagonal slash on a white rounded tile.
brandProvenance.nativePackaging: App/AppIcon.icon and Apple native icon compiler

nativePlatform.componentPreview: Source descriptions for native SwiftUI/AppKit components. No HTML/CSS facsimiles or synthetic tonal ramps: these would replace native controls, dynamic platform colors, materials or terminal rendering. Frontmatter is the primitive token authority.

evidence.mode: Authorized refresh of incumbent design system; current native source scan and supplied screenshot inspection.
evidence.captureLimit: Refreshed workbench captures show label-colored state words and pane main titles. The captures establish only their shown states, not every accent or accessibility condition.
evidence.renderAcceptance: No new app render or GUI operation performed by the documenter; screenshot inspection is limited to supplied states.
evidence.behaviorAcceptance: No full C01–C90, accent/contrast, VoiceOver, IME, performance or external-service acceptance claim. Current results live in docs/ux-audit/RESULTS.md.
evidence.scopeRemoval: Agent launcher and command overrides, file tree, preview, transfer, attachment delivery and clipboard file/image interception are removed. C86–C90 and UX28 are REMOVED_BY_SCOPE.

components.name: Chrome Action
components.description: Compact native borderless action with neutral chrome tint, SF Symbol and contextual help; native focus and disabled states.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Full-row plain buttons in persistent collapsible groups with pinned headers; selected accent wash/outline and neutral hover.

components.name: Agent Row and Status
components.description: Two lines: task plus status glyph, then tool/Space/device context plus primary-colored state word. Real optional metadata stays in full help.

components.name: Terminal Tab
components.description: Natural-width AppKit tab, semibold selection, accent wash/outline, neutral hover, full-title help, automatic selected-tab reveal and reorder marker.

components.name: Terminal Pane
components.description: Real Ghostty surface with embedded label-color task title and secondary context; key-window focus uses semibold title and accent border. Adjustable native splitters, close and restore controls.

components.name: Search
components.description: Borderless native text field and content-sized results, with type/context/status, shared hover and keyboard selection, stable identity and keyboard hints.

components.name: Settings
components.description: Four top-level native sections: Appearance, Terminal, Connections, About & Updates. Advanced Tailcat and generic Plugins are nested in Connections.

components.name: New Space
components.description: Native named-directory form bound to the chosen device, with busy/validation/error state and native cancel/default actions.

components.name: Recovery Overlay
components.description: Compact native regular-material explanation with Reopen for ended local shells or Reconnect for ended server attachment.

narrative.overview:
HerdrX is a quiet native macOS workbench. Terminals own the visual field; compact navigation keeps each task, device and session clear. Neutral controls recede around task names, readable state labels and focused terminal content.

SwiftUI and AppKit supply system typography, familiar controls and keyboard behavior; Ghostty supplies the real terminal canvas. Preserve HerdrX's name and the user-supplied purple diagonal slash on a white icon tile. The original artwork, native Icon Composer packaging and provenance remain documented in [Resources/Icon/README.md](Resources/Icon/README.md) and [Resources/Icon/Prompt.txt](Resources/Icon/Prompt.txt); this refresh creates no raster assets.
keyCharacteristics: Terminal-first density with one integrated top bar.
Neutral chrome, semantic text and distinct selection, focus and execution signals.
Task-first, two-line Agent rows with device and session context available.
Compact native search, four-section settings and adjustable pane boundaries.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Keep platform colors semantic and source-defined theme colors explicit. Do not freeze a screenshot's appearance into a new palette.

rules.name: The Readable State Rule
rules.body: Keep Agent state words and pane main titles in native label colors; put saturated status and focus color on glyphs and borders.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve native text metrics and user-selected terminal typography; truncate navigation labels and retain their full context in tooltips.

rules.name: The Terminal Space Rule
rules.body: Keep the main detail area available to real terminal panes and keep supporting navigation compact.

dos: Do retain HerdrX identity, original icon provenance and native SwiftUI/AppKit controls.
Do keep terminal content dominant, task names primary and device/session context available.
Do use native label colors for state words and pane main titles, with shape and color for status glyphs.
Do preserve Ghostty appearance, font and input preferences while refining chrome.
Do verify both appearances, long Chinese labels, keyboard navigation and accessible splitters in the running native app.
Do keep source observations, supplied captures and completed runtime acceptance separate.
donts: Don't restore Agent launching, command overrides, file trees, previews, transfer or attachment delivery removed by current scope.
Don't replace native controls or real terminal content with a web theme, raster mockup or simulated terminal.
Don't restore a second fixed toolbar or persistent bottom status bar.
Don't invent fixed equivalents for macOS dynamic colors or platform text styles.
Don't add decorative shadows, oversized branding or card containers around terminal panes.
Don't invent runtime metadata or claim full contrast, input, accessibility or parity acceptance from screenshots.
